title: eval-harness: improve CI prompt-regression hooks and metrics integration
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Recent regressions from model rollouts highlighted brittleness in our CI prompt-regression hooks: slow eval runs, flaky metric uploads, and opaque failures. This PR streamlines the CI path for eval-harness prompt-regression checks, adds more robust retrying and backoff for metrics ingestion, and improves developer-facing diagnostics in CI logs. Changes include: 1) move lightweight prompt-subset runs to a fast-test job that runs on PRs to provide quick feedback, 2) parallelize per-model eval shard runners in the CI container with a configurable shard count, 3) add a metrics uploader with exponential backoff (+ jitter) and improved error classification (retryable vs terminal), 4) surface per-prompt-set diffs and sample failures in the PR comment and CI artifacts, 5) add feature flag to opt into strict quality gating (fail PR on specified metric drops) and default it off for gradual rollout. Checklist: - [x] implement fast-test job and sharder - [x] metrics uploader with retries - [x] PR comment summarizer and artifact links - [x] tests for uploader retry logic and sharder unit tests - [x] docs update in eval-harness/README about CI hooks Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless repo config flips strict gating. Rollout plan: enable fast-test job for all PRs immediately; enable strict gating for internal repos only after 2 weeks of observation. Related Linear: ENG-2145, ENG-2198.
